description: WBCQ P3 evaluation corpus (RFC #1093). Each entry is a step function `unsigned step(ctx *, unsigned in)`; `context_bytes` is sizeof(ctx). `calls` (P4) bounds how many calls one step makes; each call's return is an input. `regions` (P4 step 2) gives a pointer field the bytes of a named table (`region_tables.py`), on both the engine's side and the ground truth's. `globals` (P4 step 3) lists the global variables the ground truth keeps as state. `expect` is what the RFC requires of the engine: `machine` (a quotient), or for a negative case any of `fail_closed` statuses.

functions.name: lex_step
functions.origin: lexer over the C library's isdigit/isalpha (P4: classifier calls)

functions.name: door_step
functions.origin: garage door controller logging each change with putchar (P4: logging call)

functions.name: turnstile_step
functions.origin: coin turnstile with an application logger no library describes (P4: unknown callee)

functions.name: hs_step
functions.origin: greeting handshake that aborts on a protocol violation (P4: no-return callee)

functions.name: emit_step
functions.origin: parity reporter returning what putchar returned (P4: tail call)

functions.name: tdfa_step
functions.origin: table-driven number lexer: class and transition tables behind context pointers (P4 step 2: indexed reads)

functions.name: kw_step
functions.origin: SMTP HELO keyword matcher reading its keyword at the match position (P4 step 2: a read indexed by the state)

functions.name: ring_step
functions.origin: four-bit delay line over a ring buffer written at its head (P4 step 2: indexed writes)

functions.name: gcmd_step
functions.origin: command parser over a constant class table, its mode in a global (P4 step 3: globals, indexed read-only data)

functions.name: abp_step
functions.origin: alternating-bit protocol receiver with its expected bit in a global (P4 step 3: writable globals)

functions.name: gring_step
functions.origin: four-bit delay line behind a global pointer (P4 step 3: a region behind a global)
